Predicates:
WildTurkey(x) ::: x is a wild turkey.
TypeEastern(x) ::: x is an Eastern wild turkey.
TypeOsceola(x) ::: x is an Osceola wild turkey.
TypeGoulds(x) ::: x is a Gould’s wild turkey.

Premises:
∀x (WildTurkey(x) → (TypeEastern(x) ∨ TypeOsceola(x) ∨ TypeGoulds(x) ∨ TypeMerrims(x) ∨ TypeRioGrande(x) ∨ TypeOcellated(x))) ::: There are six types of wild turkeys: Eastern wild turkey, Osceola wild turkey, Gould’s wild turkey, Merriam’s wild turkey, Rio Grande wild turkey, and Ocellated wild turkey.
